description: Engine trial (finale F14): a forced phone call that rings again and resumes at the unanswered choice, a text arriving during the call, a second speaker in HaX's thread, and a computed closing card with per-person credits.
test_objective: Forced call: Esc ignored, re-ring on close resumes at the unanswered choice; closing card, teaser and per-person credit blocks render from globals
